head: Saturday night
nobody: Nobody came tonight. Only the clock, ticking.
title: {name} ({occ}) {kind}
kind_expose: came to tell on someone else
take_tip: Take the money and this story shouldn't run. Print it anyway and you'll have an enemy.
promise_alias_tip: A false name or no name keeps the promise. Print their name and they will remember you broke your word.
promise_hold: Back down: not in this issue
promise_hold_tip: Leave it out this Sunday and the promise is kept. Print it, and you are defying them to their face.
promise_no_hold: Ignore it, and see them out
take_note: Take the money and the story should not run: run it and you lose both ways. Even unprinted, word of the money may get out.
